description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally II Creature Subtype(s) Bee — Elemental (Minor) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Tarantula — Vulture (Avian) Wild Rat — Wolf — This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 2nd-level list, or 1d3 1st-level creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list .
